data.long_meaning: The name Fiza is derived from the Arabic word 'fizah' which means 'radiance' or 'blooming'. It is a beautiful name that evokes feelings of joy, happiness and beauty. The name Fiza carries the meaning “Blooming, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Fiza usually hope their child will grow to embody blooming, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fiza is a name that represents the inner radiance and beauty of a person. It is a reminder to always strive to be joyful, kind and beautiful in every aspect of life.
data.etymology: Fiza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blooming, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fiza total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Fiza bint al-Hussein, the sister of the Umayyad Caliph Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik, was known for her great beauty and exceptional piety. She is said to have lived during the late Umayyad period, around 725 AD.

Another Fiza, a prominent figure in the Tang Dynasty China, is known for her involvement in the transmission of Islamic knowledge from the Middle East to China. She was a princess of the Turkish Turks and is believed to have lived between the 7th and 8th centuries AD.
